learning_outcomes.text: Technical drawing basic definitions and principles are defined.
Gains knowledge to realize the drawings of objects.
Gains the skill to read technical drawings.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Technical Drawing and Standards, Basics of Process Drawings, Process Flow Diagrams and Representation of Process Flows
Process Flow Diagrams and Representation of Process Flows, Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams, Process Control, Process Control Diagrams
Introduction to Heat Exchangers and Technical Representation, Heat Exchanger Design and Effective Heat Transfer Area, Technical Drawing and Design Approaches of Distillation Columns
Fundamentals of 3D Modeling from 2D Technical Drawings, Multi-View Projection, Orthographic Presentations, Projection of Objects
Fundamentals of 3D Modeling from 2D Technical Drawings, Multi-View Projection, Orthographic Presentations, Projection of Objects
Line types and application areas, Introduction to CAD (Computer-Aided Design) software
Computer-Aided Two-Dimensional Drawing, Projection Method, Perspectives, Isometric and Dimetric Projections
Introduction to Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) and Geometry Preparation Principles, Computer-Aided Geometry Creation, Editing and Simplification suitable for CFD
Computer-Aided Geometry Creation, Mesh Generation and Optimization suitable for CFD, Geometry-Mesh Compatibility and Mesh Quality
Sectional views, Sectioning, Lines in section, Cutting plane, Hatching
Types of Sectional Views, Full Section, Half Section, Partial Section, Revolved Section
Dimensioning, Basic Dimensioning Rules, Lines Used in Dimensioning
bibliography: Frederick E. Giesecke, Alva E. Mitchell, Henry C. Spencer, Ivan Leroy Hill, John Thomas Dygdon, James E. Novak, R. O. Loving, Shawna E. Lockhart, Cindy Johnson, Technical Drawing with Engineering Graphics, 15th Edition, Peachpit Press, 2016
Cecil Jensen, Jay D. Helsel, Dennis R. Short, Engineering Drawing & Design, 7th Edition, McGraw-Hill Higher Education, 2007

K. Venkata Reddy, Textbook of Engineering Drawing, 2nd Edition, B. S. Publications, 2008 https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/mechanical-engineering/2-007-design-and-manufacturing-i-spring-2009/related-resources/drawing_and_sketching/
Himmelblau, D. M., Riggs, J. B. (2004). Basic principles and calculations in chemical engineering (7th ed.). Prentice Hall.
Towler, G., Sinnott, R. (2013). Chemical engineering design: Principles, practice and economics of plant and process design (2nd ed.). Butterworth-Heinemann.
